== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|A Stormwing is a dangerous type of [[Kameira]], specifically one that can be soulbound to a person. These creatures are massive, comparable in size to a large ship, and possess a physical form similar to a manta ray. They are characterized by a bright, rippling luminescence that travels through their spine and along the tip of their tail. This bioluminescence is highly potent; when the creature lashes its tail against the water or an object, it can trigger explosive flashes of light and intense heat. The Stormwing's tail and spine are large enough to span the width of a ship, and they leak a glowing yellow-white fluid when severed. In combat, these creatures can use their tails to cause concussive damage or strike with blinding light. They are known to glide over stormy waves and can be heard screaming or howling during their movements.}}
